$description: Boundry company and product identity. Source of truth for the --stack-brand-* and --stack-product-* custom properties in tokens.css and for the product accents every Boundry site and product shell uses. Identity is never a state colour: status, evidence and action tokens do not change with the product (docs/brand.md §5).

products.$source: FeltDB, FeltKit and AppBoundry accents come from each product's own logo and website (docs/decisions.md D30); AuthBoundry and AppPort have no accent of their own yet and keep the values first published on boundry.company. rkendel1/boundry reads these values from the vendored release.
